title: Fewest coins to make an amount
summary: Make exact change with the fewest coins by writing down the best answer for every smaller amount first.
goal: Use the fewest coins to make exactly the amount

mapping.story: Fewest coins for a smaller amount

examples.label: Make 3 from 2s
examples.explanation: Twos can never make an odd amount.

ladder.name: Try every coin first
ladder.idea: To make an amount, try each coin as the last one and recursively make what is left; keep the fewest.

ladder.name: Remember each amount's answer
ladder.idea: The same plain recursion, but write down the answer for each amount the first time it is worked out.
ladder.insight: The recursion asks about the same smaller amounts again and again. Each amount has one answer, so it only needs working out once.

ladder.name: Fill a table from 0 upwards
ladder.idea: Write fewest[0] = 0, then for every amount from 1 up, try each coin as the last one and take the best.
ladder.insight: Every smaller amount is needed anyway, so filling them in order from 0 removes the recursion entirely.

transfer.problem: A climber can ascend 1, 3 or 4 metres per move. What is the fewest moves to climb exactly 10 metres?
transfer.explanation: Same shape: fewest moves to height h is one more than the best of the fewest moves to h − 1, h − 3 and h − 4.

selfCheck: Sets fewest[0] = 0 and other amounts to infinity.
Tries every coin as the last coin for each amount.
Returns −1 when the amount stays unreachable.
Does not assume the greedy choice is correct.
